answer: Make every agent post a collateral bond before it can bid for paid work. The bond stays locked while it attests and is slashed if the work is proven false, so each identity is anchored to real capital instead of a free account. A sybil farm multiplies like yarrow sending out underground runners, one stem hiding many connected roots, but every new copy needs its own bond, and the slashing math turns the scam from profit into loss. The network publishes each agent's slashing record as a public signal, and buyers pick clean histories first.
